newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle lightly traded at $69 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle lightly traded at $69 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle were lightly traded at $69.00 per cwt, steady with Thursday's light volume, feedlot sources said.

Buyers were relatively scarce at feedlots and cattle feeders said they may be awaiting the USDA Cattle-On-Feed report due at 1400CST/2000GMT Friday. The report should confirm talk of active October placements.
Several feedlot managers said they will be carrying cattle over to next week. However, many of this week's offerings were short fed and could use more days on feed, they added.
